title: Pharmacokinetics of Clinically Applied Boron-Containing Compounds.
what: Pharmacology of boron-containing compounds suggests diverse novel advancements within the domain of medical chemistry. In the context of cancer, infectious, dermatological, and inflammatory disorders, boron atoms have distinctive electronic characteristics and the potential for reversible covalent bonding.

title: Prediction of Drug Transporter-Mediated Disposition, Tissue Concentration, and Drug-Drug Interaction.
what: Drug transporters play a crucial role in drug elimination and tissue distribution. This chapter focuses particularly on the liver, which expresses clinically important transporters, summarizing the latest findings on appropriate experimental tools, methodologies, and strategies for quantitatively understanding/predicting transporter-mediated drug distribution and elimination.
